behaviors.description: Read related-ref policy booleans from public-property fixtures.
behaviors.preconditions: Public properties set opposite download/delete values and both autoprune values; no extension metadata is parsed.
behaviors.expected: Each getter matches its own explicit boolean. This checks policy reporting only, not extension discovery, policy derivation or transaction execution.
references: common/flatpak-related-ref.c: public should-download, should-delete, should-autoprune properties and getters

behaviors.description: Read partial and full related-ref subpaths from public-property fixtures.
behaviors.preconditions: Public subpaths property is /en,/sv or NULL; no repository or installation supplies the object.
behaviors.expected: The partial result contains exactly the two paths and terminator; full result is NULL. This checks subpath reporting only, not selection or deployment of files.

behaviors.description: Resolve contrasting download/delete policies from declared extensions.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent policy repository; empty installation; Automatic declares no-autodownload=false/autodelete=false and Optional declares both true.
behaviors.expected: Exactly both extension identities and fixture commits; should_download/should_delete are true/false for Automatic and false/true for Optional; fetched main metadata matches independent exported declarations.

mappings.rationale: Autoprune explicitly permits public-property fixtures. Download/delete getters remain useful property checks but receive no metadata-to-policy derivation credit here; that contract is tested by queryx-related-policy using actual extension declarations.

The public subpaths property supplies the fixture's declared partial set; exact paths and terminator, plus NULL for all files, are asserted through the getter. This covers object-level reporting, not subpath selection from metadata or partial deployment.

Real reference-exported extension declarations produce opposite download/delete results on public related-ref enumeration; exact membership, commits, absent installed state and fetched declaration bytes are asserted without fabricated result properties.
